description: Guarded shared-link read (integrations/shared_link.py): the webUrl of one root file (<= 1 MB) of SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID resolved through GET /v1.0/shares/{u!base64url}/driveItem, its bytes read through GET /v1.0/drives/{drive}/items/{item}/content (302 Location fetched credential-free on the pinned tenant host), compared with the drive's own download-URL read. Output: counts and booleans only (no URL, name or id).
notes: Injected-transport tested (integrations/tests/test_shared_link.py); live-unverified until the live check records a pass. Unverified live: that Graph resolves an item's own webUrl (not only a created sharing link) through /shares/, and that /content answers 302 for app-only tokens; a failure on either reads as an http_status/error_code, never a pass. registry_names: the source registry credits a Graph endpoint template only through operations_read, the grammar operations (integrations/live_source_grammar.py) this run's GETs were answered for (the /shares/ resolution and the /content read included).
